summary: Removes a physics-object node from a global doubly-linked list (head at dword_8B8F14, prev/next links at node +0x12C/+0x130). Walks the next-pointer chain from the head until the target node a1 is found; returns 0 early if the chain ends without a match. Unlinks by patching the predecessor's next and the successor's prev, then if the node has no predecessor updates the global head to its successor. Runs DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks and EmptyStub_7470 on the node, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and decrements the global physics-object count at dword_8B6AC0.

local_names.a1: target node to unlink and free
local_names.result: list cursor walking the next-pointer chain, starting at the head

operations.description: Removal logic runs only while the global list head at dword_8B8F14 is non-null
Walk the next-pointer chain at +0x130 from the head until the cursor equals a1; if the chain reaches 0 first, return 0 without unlinking
Unlink from the left: if the predecessor at +0x12C is non-null, its next pointer (+0x130) is set to the node's successor
Unlink from the right: if the successor at +0x130 is non-null, its prev pointer (+0x12C) is set to the node's predecessor
Head update: when the node has no predecessor (a1[75] at +0x12C is zero), the global head dword_8B8F14 becomes a1[76], the node's successor at +0x130
DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks(a1) cleans up two fields of the node before teardown
EmptyStub_7470(a1) is invoked as a debug/logging stub on the node
Global physics-object count at dword_8B6AC0 is decremented after the removal
Returns 0 on both the not-found and the successful-removal paths

Reached from many cockpit, pit-crew, animation and special-FX setup/teardown paths (0049b0a0, 0049ca00, 0049cd80, 004a3220, 004a3910, 004a4900, 004cf070, 004d0110, 004d1450, 004d8ab0, 004dcba0, 004ddad0, 004f8d70, 004fc550) as a shared node teardown helper
